_comment: Minimal fixture for the SAM4E8E boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit (PMC_SR flipflop + SAM4S_EEFC model on the local sam4e8e.repl) and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the UART0 pty Renode exposes. AFEC0/AFEC1 stub regions are injected by the launcher but are not driven here - they exist to keep ADC reads from faulting if SystemInit happens to touch them.
